items.title: HTTPS enabled
items.description: Site serves over HTTPS with valid TLS certificate.
items.how_to_evaluate: Request URL. Scheme must be https; status 200 without mixed-content warnings.

items.title: robots.txt allows crawlers
items.description: robots.txt does not block important paths.
items.how_to_evaluate: Fetch /robots.txt; look for Disallow: / or UA-specific blocks on Googlebot/Bingbot.

items.title: Key pages return 2xx
items.description: No 4xx or 5xx errors on crawled pages.
items.how_to_evaluate: Record HTTP status during crawl; any 4xx/5xx is a failure.

items.title: Sitemap present and valid
items.description: XML sitemap is discoverable (robots.txt or /sitemap.xml) and parses.
items.how_to_evaluate: Check robots.txt for Sitemap: directive; fall back to /sitemap.xml. Parse XML.

items.title: Canonical tag
items.description: Self-referencing canonical on every page.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if canonical present and self-references on all pages; 5 if partial; 0 if missing everywhere.

items.title: Viewport meta tag
items.description: Mobile viewport meta present.
items.how_to_evaluate: Look for <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width...'> in head.

items.title: Charset UTF-8
items.description: Document declares UTF-8 encoding.
items.how_to_evaluate: Look for <meta charset='utf-8'> or equivalent.

items.title: <html lang> attribute
items.description: HTML element has a lang attribute.
items.how_to_evaluate: Check root <html> tag for lang attribute.

items.title: Open Graph tags
items.description: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url present.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if all four OG tags; 5 if partial; 0 if none.

items.title: Twitter Card
items.description: twitter:card meta present.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if twitter:card present; 0 otherwise.

items.title: Mobile-friendly signals
items.description: Viewport + responsive CSS clues.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if viewport + responsive clues; 6 if viewport only; 0 if none.

items.title: hreflang tags
items.description: hreflang annotations for all target countries.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if full coverage of target countries; 5 if partial; 0 if missing.

items.title: Geo-targeting strategy
items.description: ccTLD / subfolder / subdomain strategy for international.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 ccTLD or subfolder with hreflang; 7 subdomain; 0 no strategy.

items.title: html lang matches primary target locale
items.description: e.g. en-GH when Ghana is the primary country.
items.how_to_evaluate: Fail if lang attribute missing or mismatches primary country.

items.title: <title> tag present
items.description: Every page has a title tag.

items.title: H1 present
items.description: Every page has exactly one H1.

items.title: Title length and keyword
items.description: 50–60 chars with keyword near start.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if 50–60 chars + keyword near start; 6 right length no keyword; 3 wrong length; 0 missing.

items.title: Meta description
items.description: 150–160 chars with keyword + CTA.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 if 150–160 chars with keyword + CTA; 5 if present but wrong length; 0 if missing.

items.title: H1 contains target keyword
items.description: H1 contains or clearly relates to target keyword.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 yes; 5 partially relevant; 2 brand-only or irrelevant.

items.title: Heading hierarchy
items.description: Clean H1 → H2 → H3 order with no skips.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 clean; 6 minor skip; 0 broken.

items.title: Image alt text coverage
items.description: Percent of images with descriptive alt attributes.

items.title: Direct answer in first 200 words
items.description: Clear Who/What/Why answer near the top.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 clear quotable answer; 5 partially answers; 0 no direct answer.

items.title: E-E-A-T signals
items.description: Author bylines, About page, team, citations.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 all four signals; 5 About page only; 0 nothing.

items.title: FAQ section
items.description: Dedicated FAQ content, ideally with FAQPage schema.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 FAQ with schema; 6 FAQ without schema; 0 no FAQ.

items.title: Content depth vs competitors
items.description: Coverage and comprehensiveness relative to top 3 competitors.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 more comprehensive; 6 comparable; 3 thinner; 0 very thin.

items.title: Keyword presence
items.description: Primary in title+H1+intro; secondary in H2s.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 full coverage; 5 partial; 0 absent.

items.title: Internal links per page
items.description: 5+ relevant internal links per content page.

items.title: Anchor text quality
items.description: Descriptive anchor text, no generic 'click here'.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 descriptive; 3 generic; 0 none.

items.title: External authority links
items.description: 2+ links to authoritative sources.

items.title: Broken links
items.description: No 4xx/5xx internal links.

items.title: JSON-LD present
items.description: Any JSON-LD structured data on the page.

items.title: Page-appropriate schema types
items.description: Schema matches what the page is (homepage, blog post, FAQ, etc.).
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 all expected; 7 most; 4 homepage-only; 0 wrong types.

items.title: Missing expected schema
items.description: No expected schema types missing.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 none missing; 7 one missing; 4 two–three missing; 0 four+ missing.

items.title: Organization schema
items.description: Organization schema with name + url + logo + sameAs.
items.how_to_evaluate: 10 complete; 5 partial; 0 absent.

items.title: Direct answer potential
items.description: Quotable answer to a Who/What/Why query in the first 200 words.
items.how_to_evaluate: 25 clear quotable single-sentence answer; 15 buried past 200 words; 5 topic only, no answer; 0 no relevant answer.

items.title: Citation readiness
items.description: Claim-evidence blocks with numbers, dates, sources.
items.how_to_evaluate: 25 multiple claim-evidence blocks with specific numbers, dates, sources; 15 some claims with evidence; 5 claims but no numbers/sources; 0 purely promotional.

items.title: Information gain
items.description: Unique data or framework not found on top 5 competitors.
items.how_to_evaluate: 25 unique data / first-hand / original framework; 15 some unique angles; 5 near-duplicate of competitors; 0 pure commodity content.

items.title: Structured data for AI
items.description: Schema + llms.txt + E-E-A-T so AI can parse the page cleanly.
items.how_to_evaluate: 25 schema + llms.txt + E-E-A-T all present; 15 partial; 5 minimal; 0 none.
